title: Fifty Famous Fables
author: Lida B. (Lida Brown) McMurry
longDescription: McMurry is a children's collection of fables written in the early 20th century. The book is designed for young readers, likely aimed at primary school students, and presents a series of moral stories that impart valuable life lessons through simple narratives involving animals.

authorInfo.bio: Lida B. (Lida Brown) McMurry (1853–1942) is the author of Fifty Famous Fables. This historical edition is part of the author’s surviving literary work. Explore the linked biographical record for their life and bibliography.
